name: device-login-cancel

graded_by.test: core/internal/ws/device_login_test.go — TestCancelOrClosingTheSocketDisconnectsTheWorkerAndEnds4016: disconnect sent, result cancelled, close 4016, and the cap's place given back once

description: A pane that sends `device_login_cancel`, or closes its socket, before the core acts on `connected` ends the device login: the core sends C3 `disconnect`, sends `device_login_result {outcome: cancelled}` when the socket is still there, and closes 4016 `device_login_ended`. It writes `target.auth_failed` when at least one answered attempt was made. The core never waits for the worker's `connection_lost`: the result and the close go at once (L7). 4016 means no session exists, so a client MUST NOT reattach, and it may start a new device login.
corpus: device-login, how a device login ends
